newsitem.title: USA: WTC Q3 hurt by product shipping delays.
newsitem.headline: WTC Q3 hurt by product shipping delays.

text.p: WTC Industries Inc said Monday its third-quarter sales were lower than anticipated because of delays in shipping products to a major appliance manufacturer.
"We are optimistic of our sales growth in both the domestic and international markets with the PentaPure Inline product line," said chief executive officer Robert Klas Sr.
The company, a manufacturer of water filtration products, reported a third-quarter loss of $356,076 or $0.03 per share. Sales were $818,166 compared with $798,717 in the same year-ago period.
The company said it will continue with its plan to raise capital and reduce staff in the fourth quarter.
